reply.text:
I'm not going to build a plan around being as skinny as possible, fast, or around being hungry. That is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, and I'd say the same to anyone who put it that way. A thigh gap also comes down to how your hips and bones are built, so no amount of training or eating less will reliably create one.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to help with the training side: getting stronger, building energy and fitness, and feeling good in your body.
